description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the ProjectReportAPI in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It tests retrieval of project report data via the API, as well as some unimplemented API methods like delete and update, ensuring proper exception handling.

classes.name: ProjectReportAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ProjectReportAPI endpoint in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes tests for 'getOne' retrieval and verifies that 'delete' and 'update' methods throw not implemented exceptions.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the API's ability to retrieve a project report using provided test case parameters, including data setup and mock authentication.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the 'testGetOne' method, reading from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that calling delete on the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving validation rules for delete throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that calling update on the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving validation rules for update throws a not implemented exception.
